args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@Gideon Sato here's the draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from the #inc-vtg-hartford log (times are Central, Aug 3):

Subject: Hartford gate kiosks, incident summary (Aug 3, 2026)

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. First check-in after recovery went through (trailer 8836, visible to dispatch).
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for the procurement login was still being chased at the time of the update; screenshot is on ticket INC-4821.

Let me know if you want a different subject or any of these lines changed before it goes out.

I posted the draft as a reply in #strategic-random, in your thread.

Times are from the #inc-vtg-hartford log, Aug 3, Central:

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosks, incident summary (Aug 3, 2026). Times are Central.

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on so reconnect attempts could be logged.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. First check-in after recovery went through (trailer 8836, visible to dispatch).
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for the procurement login is still being tracked in INC-4821 (screenshot attached to the ticket).

Posted the FINAL summary in #strategic-random as its own message. It adds Carrowmere's gateway check (Odile Brandt) and tracks status-page access under INC-4821.

Nadia Fennimore is in #strategic-random but not in #inc-vtg-hartford. The content is operational, not finance, so it's fine to share there, but she will see the incident detail for the first time.
